screen.cosmicdungeon.help.main.body: A dungeon-focused adventure pack with classes, progression, trading, quests, and codex guidance.
screen.cosmicdungeon.help.get_started.bo: Start with class selection, follow dungeon prompts, stay with your party, and use H whenever you need a quick reference.
screen.cosmicdungeon.help.dungeons.body: Dungeon runs use active parties, Group Leader flow, objectives, key progression items, and server-validated reward checks.
screen.cosmicdungeon.help.codex.body: Quick player reference for safe commands, currency, trading, progression, factions, teleportation, and achievements.
screen.cosmicdungeon.help.class.theurgis: Theurgists are healing and potion-brewing support characters. Only Theurgists can use brewing stands, and valid potion brews finish instantly.
screen.cosmicdungeon.help.class.pyroclas: Pyroclasts bring fire and demolition themes, including a current gravel-plus-flint gunpowder crafting recipe.
Bogatyrs are rugged survivalist fighters themed around endurance, traditional weaponry, and wolf companionship.
Melee-forward Dragoon fighters can trigger chain lightning on weapon hits, use Dragoon-attuned gear, open Dragoon chests, and are the class allowed to use anvils for vanilla repair support.
Venefex characters focus on poison, debuff, and attrition themes while using Venefex-attuned gear and chests.
screen.cosmicdungeon.help.class.judicato: Judicators use Judicator-attuned gear and Judicator class chests. They are not the anvil/repair-support class; anvil access belongs to Dragoons.
screen.cosmicdungeon.help.class.metalman: Metalmancer is disabled and coming in Dungeon 2.
